proposal.key: whole record line (description + linking word + name)
proposal.threshold_reason: 19.2f measured a median order-induced score difference of 1.24; a key difference must clear the 8.88e-16 noise floor and be comparable with the score scale

baseline_duplicates.note: 19.2n measured the same quantity as 0/384; this row only rechecks it 0 Adam

margin.reason: the role-swapped counterpart must be a real in-pool record (owner 1.3); no world contains one, so scoring would require a synthesised decoy, which is forbidden

verdict.label: proposal_not_admissible
verdict.reason: two independent blockers: (i) reading 1.2(a) clears 0.5 on only 81/96 record lines (min 0.326), so the role marker is not a uniform separator; (ii) readings 1.2(b) and 1.3 both need a role-swapped *record* inside the pool, and the record vocabulary keeps descriptions and names disjoint, so no world contains such a pair (0/12) and the mandated numbers cannot be produced without synthesising a record, which the gate forbids
verdict.narrowing: the key is not a bag: no swapped line shares the gold key (0/96 identical, min 0.326 >> 8.88e-16); the blockers are the 0.5 bar on part of the lines and the missing in-pool counterpart

boundary: this gate only says whether a role-swapped opponent can exist inside the pool under the whole-line key; it says nothing about whether training can learn the distinction
